rules.rule_name: Prohibition of Proprietary Brand Names in Tender Specifications
rules.authority: CVC Office Memorandum No. 03-05-1-CTE-9 / Manual for Procurement of Goods Rule 144
rules.message: Specific brand names without generic technical specifications or without 'or equivalent' qualify as tender tailoring under CVC guidelines.
rules.recommended_action: Remove proprietary brand names. Specify objective parameters and relevant Indian Standard (IS) with 'or equivalent certified to IS'.

rules.rule_name: Citation of Obsolete or Withdrawn BIS Standards
rules.message: Citing obsolete revisions restricts participation and violates public procurement quality mandates.
rules.recommended_action: Update to latest valid revision and ensure compliance with current amendments.

rules.rule_name: Foreign Standards Citing Without Equivalence Clause
rules.authority: Make in India Public Procurement Order (PPO) 2017 & CVC Guidelines
rules.message: Mandating foreign standards when national standards exist discriminates against domestic manufacturers.
rules.recommended_action: Replace with harmonized Indian Standard (IS) or explicitly state 'or equivalent Indian Standard (IS)'.

rules.message: Disproportionate financial turnover or restrictive client requirements restrict competitive bidding.
rules.recommended_action: Align turnover criteria with standard formula (typically 30% to 50% of estimated tender value).

rules.rule_name: Missing Mandatory BIS Quality Control Order (QCO) Certification Clause
rules.authority: BIS Act 2016 Section 16 & Respective Ministry QCO Gazettes
rules.message: Procuring items covered under QCO without mandatory BIS standard mark is illegal.
rules.recommended_action: Insert mandatory clause: 'The supplied goods must bear valid BIS Standard Mark (ISI mark) and the manufacturer must hold a valid BIS license as on the date of bid submission.'
